description: This file manages OAuth profile authentication, including provider resolution, token refresh, credential adoption, and secret resolution within an OAuth authentication system.

methods.name: listOAuthProviderIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OAuth provider IDs from the registered providers.

methods.name: isOAuthProvider
methods.description: Checks if a given provider string is a recognized OAuth provider.

methods.name: resolveOAuthProvider
methods.description: Resolves a provider string to an OAuthProvider object if valid.

methods.name: isCompatibleModeType
methods.description: Determines if two authentication modes are compatible, considering bearer token interchangeability.

methods.name: isProfileConfigCompatible
methods.description: Checks if a profile's configuration is compatible with specified provider and mode.

methods.name: buildOAuthApiKey
methods.description: Builds an OAuth API key string from credentials, possibly formatted via plugin.

methods.name: buildApiKeyProfileResult
methods.description: Constructs a profile result object with API key, provider, and optional email.

methods.name: buildOAuthProfileResult
methods.description: Builds a profile result object for OAuth credentials, including API key and provider.

methods.name: extractErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a string message from an error object.

methods.name: adoptNewerMainOAuthCredential
methods.description: Adopts a newer OAuth credential from the main agent store if available.

methods.name: refreshOAuthTokenWithLock
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth token with file lock to ensure concurrency safety.

methods.name: tryResolveOAuthProfile
methods.description: Attempts to resolve an OAuth profile's API key, refreshing token if expired.

methods.name: resolveProfileSecretString
methods.description: Resolves secret strings or references for profile credentials.

methods.name: resolveApiKeyForProfile
methods.description: Main exported function to resolve an API key for a given profile, handling OAuth refresh, fallback, and inheritance.
